description: This Java source file defines the ItemAddFragment class, which extends DialogFragment to provide a UI dialog for adding a new item with a key-value pair in an Android application. It manages user input, validates it, and communicates the data back via a callback interface.

classes.name: ItemAddFragment
classes.description: A DialogFragment that provides a UI for adding a new restriction item with key and value inputs, validates input, and passes the data back via a listener.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Attaches the fragment to a context, initializing the callback listener, which can be either the parent fragment or context.

methods.name: onDetach
methods.description: Detaches the fragment and clears the callback listener.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout and sets the dialog title.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes input fields and sets up the OK button click listener.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events, triggers addItem() when OK button is pressed.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Validates key and value inputs; shows Toast messages if empty; calls the listener if validation passes.
